config.label: Your Kia Owners Portal / Kia Access account password
config.description: Your Kia Owners Portal / Kia Access account password.

config.label: Write-tool gate: "none" registers no vehicle commands; "comfort" registers climate and charging only; "all" adds door lock/unlock (default "comfort")
config.description: Write-tool gate: "none" registers no vehicle commands; "comfort" registers climate and charging only; "all" adds door lock/unlock (default "comfort"). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

config.label: Optional stable device UUID used for the app login handshake
config.description: Optional stable device UUID used for the app login handshake. Generated and cached under ~/.kiaaccess-mcp/ when omitted.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. A remember-me token from a completed MFA bootstrap elsewhere (copy `rmtoken` out of that machine's ~/.kiaaccess-mcp/session.json). Set it and the one-time bootstrap is skipped entirely; set KIA_DEVICE_ID to the SAME value that was in effect during the bootstrap.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Per-request deadline for Kia API calls, in milliseconds (default 30000).

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Where the session store lives (default ~/.kiaaccess-mcp/session.json).
